prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” agent for every seller in Pleasanton — the right agent depends on your house, timeline, price range, and what you value most (highest net, fastest sale, low hassle, specialized marketing, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. To start, here’s a practical plan and what to look for.

Quick plan
- Give me your address (or at least neighborhood, beds/baths, and target sale price) and your priorities (fast sale vs top dollar, willingness to do repairs/staging, timeline). I can then compile a short list of top local agents and recent comps.
- If you prefer to search yourself, interview 3–5 agents who have recently sold houses like yours in Pleasanton.

How to pick the right agent — key criteria
- Local sales track record: recent closed sales in your neighborhood, list-to-sale price ratio, and average days on market.
- Marketing plan: professional photos, floor plans, virtual tours, targeted online ads, social media, broker tours, and open houses.
- Pricing strategy and CMA: a clear Comparative Market Analysis (comps) and a recommended price range with rationale.
- Communication/style: responsiveness, availability, and how they’ll keep you updated.
- Negotiation skill: references from past clients and examples of tough negotiations.
- Team vs solo agent: teams may have broader marketing resources, solos may give more personal attention — decide which you prefer.
- Fees and net proceeds: commission percentage and any extra fees; ask for a projected net sheet.
- Reputation and reviews: Google/Yelp, Zillow/Redfin profiles, local MLS data, and references.

Where to find and vet agents
- Search recent Pleasanton MLS sales, Zillow/Redfin agent rankings, and local brokerage websites (Compass, Keller Williams Tri-Valley, Intero, Coldwell Banker, Lyon, etc.).
- Check agent bios for “Sold” listings in your specific neighborhood and price range.
- Read client reviews and ask for references from recent local sellers.

Interview questions to ask every agent (quick script)
- How many homes like mine have you sold in Pleasanton in the last 12 months?
- What was the average list-to-sale price and days on market for those?
- What’s your recommended listing price and why? Can you show a CMA?
- What’s your marketing plan (photos, video, online ads, staging, open houses)?
- Who exactly will I work with (you or your team)? Who will do showings/negotiations?
- How often and by what method will you update me?
- What are your fees, and can you provide a net proceeds estimate?
- Can you provide 2–3 recent local seller references I can call?

Red flags
- Refuses to provide recent comparable sales or references.
- Promises a specific sale price or timeframe without showing data.
- Lowball commission pitch with vague marketing promises.
- Poor communication or missed appointments during the interview process.

If you want, I can:
- Pull together a shortlist of 3–5 highly rated Pleasanton agents who have sold homes like yours (I’ll need the property address, beds/baths, and your priorities).
- Draft a script or checklist you can use when interviewing agents.
Tell me the address or the key details and what’s most important to you, and I’ll prepare a targeted shortlist.
